Designed and deployed an inventory ML pipeline with automated retraining, tracking & dashboards across 5,200 stores.
Improved recommendations for a waste app, contributing to a 35% increase in adoption.
Refactored codebase for multiple markets, reducing cloud costs by 21% and improving re-execution time.
Led a revenue forecasting team, translating stakeholder requirements into solutions with data engineering.
Built an LLM-powered agentic chatbot for tabular data to support forecast reasoning and finance workflows.
Reduced forecasting execution time from 12 days to 4 hours; achieved 98.5% reported forecast accuracy.

Improved weekly revenue forecast accuracy by 13% in collaboration with Finance and Data Engineering.

Developed transformer models using EHR data, visit-level embeddings, and RareBERT/MedBERT.
Built a patient enrollment model that improved clinical trial feasibility efficiency by 29%.
Career outcomes are drawn from my résumé. Metrics describe their respective projects and measurement contexts.
Fair Latent Representation Learning with Adaptive Reweighing
Developed a fair representation learning algorithm focused on mitigating bias in ML models.
W-Net: Simultaneous Identification of Gulf Stream and Rings
Deep learning architecture for satellite imagery to identify ocean features simultaneously.
I’m Raghav Sharma, a Senior Data Scientist at Walmart. My work spans
retail inventory systems, financial forecasting, healthcare modeling, and agentic AI.
I enjoy turning research ideas into maintainable systems: from transformer
models and fairness algorithms to ML pipelines with automated retraining.
Let’s talk about machine learning, research, and useful AI applications.
